items.title: File Einspruch against the Kfz-Steuer assessment
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat; sie beginnt mit der Bekanntgabe, die bei einfachem Brief am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden als erfolgt gilt.
items.computation: Letter dated (posted) Wed 22.10.2025. As Hauptzollamt is a tax authority administering Kfz-Steuer, the delivery fiction under §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO applies: 4th day after posting = Sun 26.10.2025. Since this is a tax authority and the 4th day falls on a Sunday, §108 Abs. 3 AO moves deemed delivery to the next working day: Mon 27.10.2025. The one-month Einspruchsfrist (§355 Abs.1 AO) runs from the delivery day (not counted itself) and ends on the day with the same number in the following month: 27.11.2025 (a Thursday, no NW holiday), so no further shift under §108 Abs.3 AO applies.
